text: １ど　なげて　つかまらなくても　あきらめないで　なんども　ボールを　なげてみて！

structure.jp: なんども　ボールを　なげてみて！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after the て-form of a verb says 'even if'. つかまらなくても = 'even if it doesn't get caught'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after the て-form of a verb means to try doing it and see what happens. Ending in て makes it a friendly request. なげてみて = 'try throwing'.

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで after a verb means 'without doing' or 'don't do'. Here it tells you not to do one thing and to do the next instead. あきらめないで = 'don't give up, but'.
